references.text: Zorah and Eshtaol are mentioned as part of the territory of the tribe of Dan, the same cities referenced in Joshua 15:33
Samson was buried between Zorah and Eshtaol, the same cities mentioned in the lowlands of Judah
The tribe of Dan sent spies from Zorah and Eshtaol, cities that also belonged to the lowland region of Judah
Six hundred men from the tribe of Dan set out from Zorah and Eshtaol, the same cities mentioned in Joshua 15:33
Eshtaol is mentioned in the genealogy of Judah, in connection with the descendants of Kiriath-jearim
